text:
Sam Wong: Heads up — seeing a consistent +10-15% tail latency on H100 for bs=1 seq=2048 in prod since the kernel-selector tweak this morning. Only affects fused+paged_flash combo, other kernels look fine. Anyone else seeing this?
Jia Patel: Saw the alert too. Bisecting now. My hunch: fallback/threshold change in the selector that biases fused for small batches. @perf-bot can you drop the microbench artifact for the failing build? :eyes:
perf-bot: perf-bot: microbench artifacts for build ker-sel-42 uploaded: https://ci.redwood/internal/artifacts/ker-sel-42/microbench.zip — includes A100/H100/L40S runs and kernel traces.
Miguel Alvarez: Quick repro on staging (H100 x1) — ran: `python bench.py --model llama-2-13b --seq 2048 --bs 1 --kernel fused_paged_flash --runs 50`
```
median latency: 312.4 ms
p95: 420.1 ms
p99: 520.3 ms
observed: kernel switch overhead ~8ms per call (cpu-side)
```
Jia Patel: Hmm CPU-side overhead + kernel hop. Do you have nvprof or Nsight counters? Could be PCIe memcpy or L2 eviction when prefetcher fills pages.
Miguel Alvarez: Attached quick nvprof extract: `nvprof --metrics gld_throughput,gld_inflight` shows memory stalls spike when seq crosses 1792->2048 on fused path. L2 miss rate up ~3x.
Sam Wong: Console traces also show KV-cache evictions spike for the same requests (route=hosted-us-east, model=redwood/llama-2-7b-quant). My guess: fused+paged prefetch tries to touch pages which causes premature eviction of hot KV entries — thrash.
Aisha Chen: For immediate mitigation we can force selector to prefer non-fused flash for bs<=2 on H100. That should bring tail back down. I can push a hotfix if we agree.
Jia Patel: Please do. Also add a debug mode env: `KERNEL_SELECTOR_DEBUG=1` so we can collect `kv_cache_evictions` + `batch_entropy` metrics alongside latency.
Sam Wong: I'll bisect selector commits in range 7f3a..9b2c to find the regression point. Can someone run a cross-GPU heatmap (A100/H100/L40S) for seq sweep 512,1024,1536,2048 and bs sweep 1,2,4? Need to confirm surface area.
Miguel Alvarez: I can run A100+H100 today. Script: `bench/heatmap.py --kernels fused_paged_flash,flash,classic --gpus A100,H100,L40S --seqs 512,1024,1536,2048 --bs 1,2,4 --out results/heatmap-247830` — uploading once done.
perf-bot: Scheduled perf job #4821 with that matrix. Results: https://ci.redwood/internal/jobs/4821 (expected ~45m).
Jia Patel: Also flagging potential batching heuristic regression: recent change increased continuous-batching timeout from 2ms -> 5ms for 'aggressive' profile. That hurts bs=1 latency if selector tries to aggregate tiny requests into fused kernels. Worth testing with timeout knob set back to 2ms.
Sam Wong: Good call. For prod rollback, Aisha — can you flip default policy to fallback-to=flash when (gpu==H100 && bs<=2 && seq>=1536)? That keeps correctness and gives us breathing room.
Aisha Chen: On it. Patch queued: `policy.yaml` diff ->
```
fallback_map:
  - condition: "gpu==H100 && bs<=2 && seq>=1536"
    kernel: flash
```
Deploying to hosted canary in 10m.
Miguel Alvarez: After perf-bot posts heatmaps I'll diff the fused vs flash heatmaps and produce a kernel-selector PR that adds an extra kv-eviction penalty term to the scoring function.
Jia Patel: Nice. If bisect points to selector commit that introduced page-prefetch heuristics, we should revert only that part and keep other selector improvements.
Sam Wong: TL;DR — regression likely from combined effect of (1) selector bias toward fused for small batches, (2) longer batching timeout, and (3) fused+paged prefetch causing KV-cache thrash. Hotfix -> prefer flash on H100 for bs<=2; run heatmap matrix; bisect to root cause.
Jia Patel: :thumbsup:
Aisha Chen: Can everyone add any failing traces to the issue I created: https://phabricator.redwood/PHID-Issue-3142 so we have one source of truth. I'll post canary metrics once deployed.
Sam Wong: Thanks team — ping me if you see regressions after flip. I’ll post bisect findings here when done.
